note_en: 不但不/没…，反而… says that not only did the expected thing not happen, the opposite did: 小美不但没有生气，反而笑着说这是她“用脚做的广告” "far from getting angry, Xiao Mei laughed and called it her 'ad made with my foot.'" 反而 means "on the contrary, instead" and flags a result that goes against expectation; it appears alone too: 锅没扔到桌子上，反而砸在了自己的脚上. English often uses "far from..." or "instead" here, never "but also."
